# VIES fixtures

All files here are **hand-written (synthetic)**, built from DESIGN.md §4.2 and the publicly
described VIES REST schema. They are NOT recordings of the live API. Field names, error codes
and the HTTP statuses used for error cases are assumptions. Replace with recorded responses (via
opt-in `Category=Live` tests) once the live API has been exercised. VAT IDs are made up.
